blocks.text: Project timelines set karne ka matlab hai yeh tay karna ke project ka har hissa kitna waqt lega. Is se project apne raaste par (on track) rehta hai aur waqt par mukammal hota hai.
Misal: agar aap website bana rahe hain to site design karne ki ek timeline, content likhne ki doosri aur sab kuch test karne ki teesri timeline rakh sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Timeline project ki kaise madad karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Har hisse ka waqt pehle se tay hota hai, is liye jaldi pata chal jata hai ke project peeche to nahi reh raha; team waqt par qadam utha kar project waqt par mukammal kar sakti hai.

items: Timelines: har hissa kitna waqt lega; project ko on track aur waqt par rakhti hain (website: design, content, testing).
